strategy_note: 3-4-3 elite pattern: safe-haven core (Haaland + MCI defensive block + Raya) with 2 calculated differentials (Bogle 4.1% TSB, Emersonn 2.8% TSB). Captain = season cum_pts leader among nailed premiums per APEX locked captaincy rule.
transfer_note: 0 transfers - squad established for GW5, 1 FT banked. No rotation-flagged starter worth a hit; forward pool beyond Haaland is thin (next best xPts 4.02 at 9.1m).
chip_note: No chip. No DGW/BGW in GW5, <3 rotation-flagged starters, 3-GW rolling projection above 55. APEX chip-timing gate says save.

budget.cap_check: max 3 per club satisfied (MCI 3: Gvardiol/Guéhi/Haaland; ARS 2; LEE 2; EVE 2; rest 1)

key_differential: Emersonn (IPS, 2.8% TSB, 3.86 xPts) - 2 goals + 1 assist in 237 mins, 4.36 ppm, cheapest route to a 3-4-3 third forward; secondary differential Bogle (LEE, 4.1% TSB, 8.57 xPts, season pts leader on 37).
risks: Emersonn fails APEX rotation gate (59 avg mins < 60) - Tavernier is first auto-sub cover.
3-4-3 leaves Tarkowski-class defensive points on the bench; accepted as the cost of the elite shape.
Captain Haaland (72.6% TSB) is zero-edge vs field; edge is built in the defence and third-forward slot instead.
reasoning: GW5 model favours defenders heavily: the three highest xPts assets in the pool are Gvardiol (10.32), Guéhi (9.00) and Bogle (8.57), and the MCI fixture is FDR 2. I take the full legal MCI allocation (Gvardiol, Guéhi, Haaland = 26.77 combined xPts for 27.2m) as the safe-haven core, pair it with Raya (40.8% TSB, FDR 3, 29 season pts) in goal, and fund a four-man midfield of Gibbs-White, Saka, Groß and Gakpo. Captaincy follows the locked APEX rule - cum_pts leader among nailed premiums - which ties Haaland and Gvardiol on 33 season points and breaks to Haaland as the outfield premium with the ceiling; Gvardiol takes the armband if Haaland is a late scratch. Differentials are deliberately cheap rather than speculative: Bogle at 4.5m is the outright season points leader (37) at 4.1% ownership, and Emersonn at 5.5m gives a 3.86 xPts third forward at 2.8% ownership without compromising the core.
